summary: Tested Offer System (Sunday/Wednesday Special Offers with 10% deposit bonus). Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed covering public /api/offers/status, /api/offers/{type}/check-active, admin GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/offers/*. Frontend: OfferSlider on Market page shows LIVE indicator + Ends In countdown correctly; Admin Panel Offers tab renders Sunday/Wednesday Special cards with datetime-local Start/End inputs, Bonus Percentage, Save & Activate / Deactivate buttons. ACTIVE badge shown for currently live Sunday offer. All 9 requested feature points verified except direct E2E deposit-bonus flow (requires Web3 wallet - verified via code review + unit tested check_any_offer_active logic).

issues: Instructions/help text (How It Works) is written in Hinglish mixed with English. Minor i18n consistency issue.

action_items: No blocking fixes needed. Optional: standardize instructions language in Admin Offers (currently Hinglish).
Consider adding data-testid attributes to Admin Offers inputs/buttons (currently works via role/text selectors, but testid would be more robust).
critical_code_review_comments: Deposit bonus logic (server.py L1410-1443) is only applied when first_investment_done=True. First-time depositors are intentionally excluded (welcome bonus takes precedence). This is by design but should be documented in the Admin Offers help text to avoid admin confusion.

OfferConfigUpdate model accepts bonus_percent but admin update_offer_config forces default 10.0 if None - correct. However, if config.is_active=False is sent, line 3500 uses `is not None` check so False is preserved - correct.

check_any_offer_active returns the FIRST matching active offer (Sunday checked before Wednesday). If both are configured as live overlapping, bonus is applied only once from Sunday - acceptable behavior.
Timezone handling uses IST localize when tzinfo is None (L3312, L3482). All comparisons done in UTC - correct.
server.py file is 3965 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline; should be modularized (existing issue, not from this feature).
seed_data_creation: Sunday offer configured as LIVE (start=-1h, end=+23h UTC) via test_restore_sunday_live_for_frontend_tests fixture to preserve expected UI state. Wednesday offer was deactivated during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend offer APIs fully validated via pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_offers.py. OfferSlider works correctly on Market page with LIVE badge + countdown. Admin Offers tab accessible via hamburger -> Offers; contains both Sunday & Wednesday configuration forms with datetime-local inputs. 10% deposit bonus logic is in server.py L1410-1443 and only applies to subsequent deposits (first_investment_done=True) during an active offer window. E2E deposit test requires real Web3 wallet so not performed - unit covered via /api/offers/{type}/check-active.
